aggregates.title: The Working City
aggregates.description: Work, is the activity involving mental or physical effort done in order to achieve a purpose or result. Cities, as micro-organisms built by and for humans are filled with endless indications of the work that not only built and maintains the cities but the work also permitted by such contraptions.

aggregates.title: The (In)hospitable City
aggregates.description: Hospitability, is the act of being friendly and welcoming to visitors or guests, a hospitable city could be said to apply such sensibilities to its public space. But does it? And who is welcoming who? From physical furniture, to signage or color indications, to technological devices, the public space is filled with more or less explicit nudges to convey whether you are welcome or not.
aggregates.curatedBy: w/ Floor van Ditzhuyzen AKA The Public Space Detective

aggregates.title: The Porous City
aggregates.description: Something is porous when it has several openings that allow easy passage (of liquid, air, things, people, information, etc.). A porous city could be imagined as one that encourages openness, exchange, interaction, and fluidity between different groups, cultural identities, and spaces. It’s a city that would value in-between spaces: leisure and work, affordable and less affordable housing, between public and private, prescriptive and open, formal and informal… It’s a city that is in a state of constant transformation, and is never fully closed off or rigidly defined.

aggregates.title: The Annotated City
aggregates.description: Annotation refers to the act of adding notes, comments, or explanations to a text, image, or other type of media. In the context of art in the public space, graffiti and street art are common forms of annotation on the urban landscape. Through the use of spray paint, stencils, stickers, and other materials, graffiti writers and other groups annotate the city with their own personal expressions, statements, and messages. These annotations can take many forms, from tags to complex murals, and can serve a variety of purposes, including artistic expression, social commentary, and political activism

aggregates.title: The Secret City
aggregates.description: From secret urinols, to misterious snail sculptures that are nowhere to be found anymore, the city is full of secrets. Some hidden in plain sight, others more elusive.
